verdict.rationale: Relay documents rule-based automation triggered by events — auto-transfer rules that move money on deposit or threshold events (relay-docs-6, relay-docs-15, relay-docs-30), plus multi-step approval rules (relay-docs-17) — which is a real form of 'define rules that trigger actions on events.' However this is narrowly scoped to cash-movement/approval workflows within banking, not a general-purpose event/action rule engine, and there's no evidence of user-defined arbitrary trigger-action logic (e.g., custom conditions, webhooks, or broader business events) an AI-native user could configure. Missing for 10: general-purpose custom trigger/action rule builder, evidence of AI-driven or user-scripted conditional logic beyond preset transfer/approval templates, and independent confirmation of rule flexibility.
